title: I’m building an AI tool that lets you create beautiful video games with no code (Concept video)
author: lukeiamyourpapi
selftext: The video is a prototype of creating a small Ghibli style RPG. We are halfway through building and looking for some feedback to see if this is the right thing to build. Happy to share the Discord link for early access and to try early builds out!

comments.author: lukeiamyourpapi
comments.body: The video above is a concept, we are still building and looking for active feedback. Join our Discord server try out early builds and give feedback: [https://discord.gg/wM7TPWPuWC](https://discord.gg/wM7TPWPuWC)

comments.author: JedahVoulThur
comments.body: How do you plan to convert text to animations? The last time I looked into it, the existing tools were very. It was many months ago though, have they improved as much as to create stable quality ones now?

comments.author: No_Surround_4662
comments.body: When you say concept video do you mean: "This is a rendered video with UI overlayed on top", or do you mean "this is a working demo that needs refining" ?

comments.author: drtreadwater
comments.body: The fact your video classes the entirety of character control as "Apply Animation " gives away that you have no idea what you're doing

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: Can you expand on what you've built here? While this looks interesting, details are pretty thin and this is on the spammy end of the spectrum. I'd bet you'd get a lot more interest if you wrote a bit more about what you're trying to achieve here.

comments.author: IncorrectAddress
comments.body:
It looks ok, but it's not much different to what someone could manually code and just allow the player to extend the functionality of entities/objects from function lists.

GL with this !

replies.author: CrimesOptimal
replies.body: It's honestly a 5-minute job in unreal engine already

comments.author: Winter-Ad781
comments.body: Oof, nope. Way too early for this tech to be effective, and this doesn't appear to be doing anything special to solve the existing problems.

comments.author: monsterfurby
comments.body:
Is the Ghibli style thing a meme now? I've seen videos with that exact phrasing in r/aivideo, in r/midjourney and in various other places. I'm getting a bit wary of that being so popular as a pitch all of a sudden.

Also, while I hope we'll get that level of game creation user experience eventually, I dunno man - this kind of thing seems destined to be able to do exactly one kind of game and just that one thing only, which kinda defeats the purpose.

comments.author: Krowsk42
comments.body: Idk why everyone is hating on you here OP. I’ve never seen something like this before and it would be one of my favorite things on earth if it were completely and reliable. Keep at it

replies.author: TakingLondon
replies.body: This is just an AI video, it's not actually creating the game from what I can tell. OP says it's just a concept so they most likely fed an AI some prompt like "make a video showing a video game being made by AI"

replies.author: Krowsk42
replies.body: Sorry, I forgot to assume the worst of people. They also say they are halfway through building, you say guilty until proven innocent. No matter what, my opinion stands, this would be hella awesome, I’ve never seen it before, and OP should keep working

replies.author: TakingLondon
replies.body: Oh no denying that it's awesome, I just think we're some ways away from getting AI games - especially ones that produce you a clean repo to then make manual adjustments to to form a coherent game

replies.author: ninjasaid13
replies.body:
> says it's just a concept so they most likely fed an AI some prompt like "make a video showing a video game being made by AI"

Well I don't think AI is capable of doing this whole video, there's extensive editing involved.

comments.author: DisasterNarrow4949
comments.body:
I would love if this could come with a RPG (D&D for example) ruleset! 

I’m not sure if this can really work for game dev as we would need it to be able to generate very complex system that are required for developing actual games. 

But it would be awesome if it was its own thing, its own game. Like comming with a RPG ruleset as I said. 

What I mean is that although it is probably too much to create a whole game with such a Tool, it would be perfect and very possible and easy to create a RPG campaign, as it seems as the perfect use case for such tool.
